name: JSON Crack
tagline: Paste JSON, see the graph. Nothing is uploaded — the file is the document.
description:
Nothing is uploaded. Paste JSON on the left and it becomes a graph of cards on the right: each object or array is a card, nested values hang off to the side, primitives stay on the parent. The last document stays inside this file, on this device. There is no account.

On a phone, Text and Graph swap so the keyboard does not cover the cards. Drag to pan, pinch or the +/− buttons to zoom. A bad paste shows a short error; the last good graph stays until you fix it. Tap a row to copy that value. Format, minify, or open a file from this device.

Press Invite in the GifOS bar to show the same document in a meeting. Either of you can type; you both see the graph.

An unofficial port of JSON Crack by Aykut Saraç. Graph view only — no accounts, no cloud, no ToDiagram.
